title: Fiorini et al. (2025). Episodic Memory in Agentic Frameworks: Suggesting Next Tasks.
senal_calidad: Only qualitative demonstration (Figs. 3-4, Sec 3); RECONSIDERAR -- evidence is illustrative-only, no quantitative retrieval or task-suggestion accuracy is reported.

title: Jiang et al. (2026). MAGMA: A Multi-Graph based Agentic Memory Architecture for AI Agents.
senal_calidad: Numeros en Sec 4.2-4.5, Tables 1-4; arXiv:2601.03236. Nota: este `key` (W7118792438) representa una version de MAGMA con representacion HIBRIDA; existe otra entrada MAGMA (W7119235481, d48) con representacion GRAFO+VECTOR — posible duplicado/version distinta del mismo paper, RECONSIDERAR.

title: Jiang et al. (2026). SYNAPSE: Empowering LLM Agents with Episodic-Semantic Memory via Spreading Activation.
senal_calidad: F facet NEGATIVO no aparece en el input (F=[WRITE,CONSOLIDACION,FIDELIDAD,RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO,COSTO]) pero el mecanismo de rejection (Sec 3.4, Table 2 fila 1) es funcionalmente conocimiento negativo — RECONSIDERAR si falta el facet NEGATIVO en la extraccion. Numeros en Sec 4.2-4.4, Tables 1,3,4; arXiv:2601.02744.

title: Hu et al. (2026). EverMemOS: A Self-Organizing Memory Operating System for Structured Long-Horizon Reasoning.
senal_calidad: Numeros en Sec 4.2, Tables 1-2, Fig 4 (ablation); arXiv:2601.02163, EverMind/Shanda Group. plan_estado=SI en input; el paper no discute planificacion de tareas del AGENTE explicitamente, solo 'foresight' de eventos/planes del USUARIO — RECONSIDERAR si el facet plan_estado esta bien asignado a este mecanismo.

title: Jiang et al. (2026). MAGMA: A Multi-Graph based Agentic Memory Architecture for AI Agents.
senal_calidad: MISMO PAPER que W7118792438 (d47) bajo un `key` distinto, con representacion GRAFO+VECTOR (vs HIBRIDA alli) y F sin el facet WRITE — RECONSIDERAR: posible entrada duplicada en el corpus con extraccion de facetas ligeramente inconsistente entre las dos filas. Numeros en Sec 4.2-4.5, Tables 1-4; arXiv:2601.03236.

title: Murugesan, T. (2026). Enhancing SWE Bench with Context Engineering: A Comparative Study Against Prompt Engineering in LLM-Based Software Tasks.
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: appears to be a template/AI-generated survey-style paper (single author, low-tier journal JISEM) -- its own 'Multi-Mode Experimental Harness' (sec2.3) and 240-task sample are described but no results table from THIS study's own run appears; all headline percentages are attributed via [3]-[6] to other, often unrelated or non-peer-reviewed sources; treat quantitative claims with caution.

title: Zhang et al. (2026). StackPlanner: A Centralized Hierarchical Multi-Agent System with Task-Experience Memory Management.
senal_calidad: Table 1 (p.6, main benchmark) + Table 4 ablation (p.7) are load-bearing; plan_estado=SI is directly satisfied by the task-memory-stack design (§3.2, Fig.2, p.4). Not RECONSIDERAR.

title: Chen et al. (2026). MemRec: Collaborative Memory-Augmented Agentic Recommender System.
senal_calidad: Numeros en Sec 3.2-3.3, Tables 2-3; arXiv:2601.08816, Snap Inc./Rutgers/HKBU. Dominio de recomendacion (no agentes conversacionales de proposito general) — el mecanismo de propagacion colaborativa aplica mejor a MF si se piensa en 'productos/factories' como nodos con senales compartidas, RECONSIDERAR aplicabilidad directa fuera de recsys.

title: Chenoweth & Chenoweth (2026). Cognitive Supply Chain Compromise: An Exhaustive Forensic Analysis of the claude-flow and agentic-flow Behavioral Injection Vulnerabilities.
senal_calidad: Security disclosure document (not a peer-reviewed paper); see 'Affected Files' and 'Vulnerability 1-6' sections. RECONSIDERAR: unusual genre for the corpus (industry vuln report vs academic memory paper) though content is squarely on WRITE/ADMISION fidelity.

title: Aubry et al. (2026). An evaluation framework for AI agent external memory systems.
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: los autores (Ontbo/Aphelior) evaluan su propio producto (Ontbo/v2) y lo reportan como el mejor de los 4 -- posible sesgo de proveedor no mitigado por terceros, pese al protocolo con criterios pre-escritos (Sec.6). Ancla: Fig.6-7 (resultados crudos y recall), Fig.9 (saturacion de ChatGPT).

title: Xiong et al. (2026). Learning to Continually Learn via Meta-learning Agentic Memory Designs.
senal_calidad: Ancla: Abstract + Tabla 1 (p.6, 4 benchmarks); meta-aprendizaje de diseños de memoria vía código en dominio de RL/agentes de juego, no memoria documental — RECONSIDERAR aplicabilidad directa al harness MF (LLM congelado + docs).

title: Chrysochos (2026). Mind-Tool: Domain Memory Architecture for AI Agents.
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: single-author, single-deployment (N=1 home-lab/small-VPS setup) case study in a journal (academicsquare-pub.com) that repeatedly frames itself as 'confirming/validating Anthropic's thesis' -- self-reported metrics (Table 1, Fig.3-5) have no control group or independent replication.

title: Cros, A. & Ava (2026). .ava -- Une notation symbolique compressee pour la memoire persistante d'agents IA.
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: self-published (Avalon Research, single independent author plus an AI-agent co-author 'Ava'), no peer review, personal-project scale (N=1 agent's memory files, 6GB consumer GPU); Table 2 (sec2.5) has compression ratios, sec4.3.5 has the V4b loss/accuracy curve, Table 3 (sec4.5) compares all 5 fine-tuning versions.

title: Tilak (2026). Continuous Memory Consolidation Without Retraining: Solving the Edge Bloat Problem Through Computational Sleep.
senal_calidad: Self-published single-author technical report (no peer venue, 'proprietary phases' undisclosed in Sec2), all numbers are from one internal developmental agent with no external baseline — RECONSIDERAR (weak evidentiary rigor for this corpus's bar).

title: Sharma (2026). Shodh-Memory: A Cognitive Memory System for Edge-Native AI Agents.
senal_calidad: Numbers from Table3/4 (Criterion.rs benchmarks) and Sec5.1/6.3; RECONSIDERAR -- retrieval-quality claims (the RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO facet) rest only on synthetic scenarios, not a standard benchmark like LOCOMO, which the paper itself lists as future work (Sec2.3, Sec6.3).

title: Kannabhiran (2026). Institutional Memory as Organizational Knowledge: AI Agents That Learn Their Jobs from Experience, Not Instructions.
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: single-author, self-published technical report (arXiv:submit, not a refereed venue), n=1 anecdotal pipeline run on a fictional company testing the author's own commercial platform (levelupctf.com); epistemic caveats on emergent expertise are acknowledged in S4.2 itself.

title: Kannabhiran (2026). Consensus-Validated Memory Improves Agent Performance on Complex Tasks.
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: same author/platform as W7133488000 and W7133519884 (self-published Technical Report, not peer-reviewed, evaluated on the author's own commercial CTF product); statistics are unusually rigorous (Mann-Whitney/Cohen's d, honest null findings, echo-chamber failure reported) for a self-published venue -- see S4.1/S4.4/S4.5.3.

title: Kannabhiran (2026). Agent Memory Infrastructure: Byzantine-Resilient Institutional Memory for Multi-Agent Systems.
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: same author/platform/venue concerns as W7133488000 and W7133508550 (self-published Technical Report, non-peer-reviewed, dhillon@levelupctf.com). Formal spec in S3-S4 (PoE formula, quorum rule); production metrics in S10.

title: Bamidele (2026). AMV-L: Lifecycle-Managed Agent Memory for Tail-Latency Control in Long-Running LLM Systems.
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: el facet plan_estado=SI parece describir el estado de ciclo de vida del ITEM de memoria (value/tier), no un plan de tarea del agente -- vale revisar si la extraccion original confundio 'estado persistente por item' con 'plan-estado'. Ancla de evidencia: Abstract (numeros TTL/LRU), Sec.4.5-4.6 (invariante de sistema), Sec.6 (transiciones de tier).

title: Li (2026). Memory as Ontology: A Constitutional Memory Architecture for Persistent Digital Citizens.
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: this is a speculative paradigm/manifesto paper (single author, self-published, explicitly 'does not claim engineering maturity or benchmark superiority,' sec1.3) with no dataset, benchmark, or measured comparison -- Table 1 (sec2.2) is its only 'evidence,' a qualitative assumptions table, not a result; treat as a design-vocabulary source, not empirical support.
